title: Expected value of a three-variable linear system
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and consider a nonempty multiset of constraints, each specifying three distinct variables of $V$ and a right-hand side in the field with two elements; a constraint is satisfied by an assignment $a:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$ exactly when the sum of its three variable values equals its right-hand side. Suppose every variable in $V$ occurs in the scope of at least one constraint. The expected fraction of satisfied constraints, counting multiplicities, under a uniformly random assignment $a:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$ is $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: Each constraint has three distinct variables
Each constraint has a right-hand side in $\mathbb{F}_2$
Every variable occurs in some constraint scope
